title: Start vitamin D3, 2,000 IU a day
body: Vitamin D was 22 ng/mL, below range. Take it with a meal that has some fat, and retest at mid-year.

title: Eat more iron-rich foods
body: Ferritin (14 ng/mL), hemoglobin and MCV were low together, a pattern of low iron stores. Pair beans, lentils, spinach and red meat with vitamin C.

title: Discuss low iron with your doctor
body: Low ferritin with low hemoglobin is worth a conversation about the cause and whether to supplement.

title: Lower saturated fat
body: LDL (132 mg/dL) and ApoB (98 mg/dL) were above range. Swap butter and fatty meats for olive oil, fish and legumes.

title: Add an omega-3 supplement or two fish meals a week
Keep up cardio three or more days a week
body: HDL rose to 61 mg/dL and hs-CRP fell to 1.4 mg/L since April.

title: Continue vitamin D3
body: Vitamin D is back in range at 34 ng/mL.

title: Choose low-mercury fish
body: Mercury was 11.2 ug/L, above range. Swap tuna and swordfish for salmon, sardines or trout, and keep tuna to once a week.

title: Talk to your doctor about LDL and ApoB
body: LDL (118 mg/dL) and ApoB (92 mg/dL) are still above range a year in. Bring these results to your annual physical.

title: Add soluble fiber
body: Oats, barley, beans and psyllium lower LDL. Aim for 10 grams of soluble fiber a day.

title: Add two strength sessions a week
body: Muscle supports insulin sensitivity; insulin is in range at 5.1 uIU/mL, keep it there.

title: Keep a regular bedtime
body: Consistent sleep supports cortisol rhythm and blood pressure.

title: Recheck morning cortisol
body: Morning cortisol was 21.4 ug/dL, just above range. Stress, poor sleep or a hard workout the day before can raise it; retest at your next visit.

title: Plan recovery during busy weeks
body: Cortisol was above range while other markers held steady. Protect sleep and lighter training in high-stress stretches.

title: Keep fish low in mercury
body: Mercury fell back in range to 6.1 ug/L.

title: LDL and ApoB are improving
body: ApoB is back in range at 86 mg/dL, and LDL fell to 109 mg/dL, still above range. Keep the fiber and fat changes and recheck in April.

title: Keep iron at food levels
body: Ferritin is 36 ng/mL and hemoglobin 13.4 g/dL, both in range. No iron supplement is needed.

title: Keep the cycling going
body: HDL reached 66 mg/dL and hs-CRP 0.8 mg/L, the best of your four visits.
